kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أتبعثر (form IIq)
# أَتَبَعْثَرُ (ʔatabaʕṯaru) /ʔa.ta.baʕ.θa.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَبَعْثَرَ (tabaʕṯara)
# أَتَبَعْثَرَ (ʔatabaʕṯara) /ʔa.ta.baʕ.θa.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَبَعْثَرَ (tabaʕṯara)
# أَتَبَعْثَرْ (ʔatabaʕṯar) /ʔa.ta.baʕ.θar/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَبَعْثَرَ (tabaʕṯara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
